verdict.rationale: Convex documents ACID transactions and fully transactional mutators, and optional schemas that enforce data shape, so the transaction part of the story is covered. Queries are written in TypeScript rather than a relational query language, and the evidence never documents joins or relational constraints such as foreign keys or uniqueness. missing for 10: documented join support, relational/referential constraints beyond schema shape validation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express relational queries with joins, constraints, and transactions

citations.quote: ACID transactions so concurrent writes never corrupt your data
Though optional, schemas ensure that your data looks exactly how you want.
queries are TypeScript code running right in the database
